name: Witch Spell
source: Akari is so happy because finally, she discovers the ultimate supersonic hypersonic love spell but not after she encounters series of unfortunate events as she tries to charm her crush, Jin Mitsuki with magic rituals. Can she still find her "Happy ever after"?
